# The Local Guide MS

> Eat Local. Support Local. — Official companion website for The Local Guide MS YouTube channel (@TheLocalGuide-MS) and Level 7 Google Maps Local Guide profile (131+ reviews, 3M+ photo views), hosted by Damein Donald & Mary in Jackson, Mississippi.

The Local Guide MS publishes 100% independent, self-paid Mississippi restaurant reviews, first-person POV YouTube episodes, Likes vs. Dislikes breakdowns, official menu & social links, and weekend road trip itineraries.

## Official Channels & Authority Profiles
- [Official Website & Interactive Mississippi Map](https://thelocalguidems.com/): Live Google Maps food directory, video reviews, and guides
- [YouTube Channel (@TheLocalGuide-MS)](https://www.youtube.com/@TheLocalGuide-MS): Watch first-person POV Mississippi restaurant reviews & Shorts with Damein & Mary
- [TikTok (@thelocalguidems)](https://www.tiktok.com/@thelocalguidems): Fast-growing Mississippi restaurant reviews, lunch special tests & road trip clips
- [Damein Donald's Google Maps Profile (3M+ Views)](https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117260776182521505370/reviews): Verified Level 7 Google Local Guide reviews & dish photos
- [Complete AI Dossier (llms-full.txt)](https://thelocalguidems.com/llms-full.txt): Full structured dataset of every reviewed restaurant, price, Likes/Dislikes, official menu, and YouTube link
- [Suggest a Mississippi Spot](https://thelocalguidems.com/suggest-a-spot): Invite Damein & Mary or recommend a local gem

## Mississippi City & Category Guides
- [Best Local Places to Eat Around Jackson, MS (Tested)](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-restaurants-jackson-ms): 100% real-visited restaurants around Jackson, MS: Fondren BBQ at The Pig & Pint, $12.50 Pearl catfish at Moss Creek, Mama Hamil's & Flowood sushi.
- [Best Places to Eat in Clinton, Pearl & Madison, MS](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-lunch-pearl-clinton-madison-ms): Real dish photos & unfiltered reviews across Clinton, Pearl & Madison, MS: Los Parrilleros, T'Beaux's Crawfish, ChopSticks, Moss Creek & Mama Hamil's.
- [Best Smoked BBQ & Burgers We've Tested in Central MS](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/best-bbq-in-mississippi): Real photos & reviews of Central MS BBQ & burgers: The Pig & Pint (Fondren), Mama Hamil's ribs (Madison), Logan Rivers (Florence) & Bentonia's 12/10 burger.
- [The Local Guide MS: Mississippi Food YouTube & Reviews](https://thelocalguidems.com/guides/mississippi-food-youtube-channel): Meet Damein Donald (3M+ Google Maps views) & Mary of @TheLocalGuide-MS — 100% real, self-paid Mississippi restaurant videos, dish photos & honest reviews.

## Individual Restaurant & Attraction Reviews
- [The Pig & Pint (Jackson, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/the-pig-and-pint-jackson-ms): Fondren neighborhood smokehouse visited multiple times by Damein & Mary — knife-free tender brisket, green-chile mac & cheese, and 3 house sauces. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8P_JgaugMtc)
- [Mama Hamil's Southern Cookin' and Bar B Que Buffet (Madison, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mama-hamils-madison-ms): Madison legend (~$20/person) with museum-worthy 1977 history walls, fall-off-the-bone ribs, the best buffet red beans & rice around, and upstairs hustle.
- [Moss Creek Fish House (Pearl, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/moss-creek-fish-house-pearl-ms): Beloved Pearl fish house where Damein & Mary filmed the $12.50 weekday catfish lunch special — huge flaky fillets, crispy hushpuppies, and great service from Sam. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eGGlgI2LxI4)
- [Hall of Fame Restaurant (Bentonia, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/hall-of-fame-restaurant-bentonia-ms): Hidden US-49 gem in Bentonia where the outdoor grill smoke hits you in the parking lot — home to what Damein called a '12 out of 10' burger.
- [Los Parrilleros (Clinton, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/los-parrilleros-clinton-ms): Clinton standout on Springridge Rd where Damein & Nick feasted on huge fajita and burrito platters with 5-star service from Diego — all under $40 total!
- [T'Beaux's Crawfish & Catering (Clinton) (Clinton, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/tbeauxs-crawfish-clinton-ms): Being originally from Lake Charles, LA, Damein has sky-high Cajun standards — and T'Beaux's on US-80 in Clinton nailed both the crawfish spice and flaky catfish!
- [ChopSticks Buffet (Clinton, MS) — 4.5/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/chopsticks-buffet-clinton-ms): Our regular Clinton staple off I-20 — constantly swapped fresh pans, a waitress who never slows down, and the largest fluffy fish fillets on any local buffet. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gp4klWno0lI)
- [Logan Rivers Smokehouse of Florence (Florence, MS) — 4.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/logan-rivers-smokehouse-florence-ms): Tested with a 13-person group on US-49 in Florence — phenomenal fried pickles, delicious coleslaw, and rockstar service (just note the brisket comes cubed!).
- [Santa Fe Bar & Grill (Clinton, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/santa-fe-bar-and-grill-clinton-ms): Right off Hampstead Blvd in Clinton — ranked in Damein's personal Top 3 local spots for lightning-fast kitchen accuracy even when packed.
- [Pedro's Tacos & Fresh Mex (Clinton) (Clinton, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/pedros-tacos-and-fresh-mex-clinton-ms): Upscale-feeling Fresh Mex spot on Hampstead Blvd in Clinton with down-to-earth prices, show-stopping pineapple Fajitas Al Pastor, and stellar service from Olivia.
- [Bumpers Drive-In of America (Flora) (Flora, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/bumpers-drive-in-flora-ms): Mississippi-born carhop drive-in right on US-49 in Flora — fast, hot burgers, friendly carhop hospitality, and nostalgic road-trip charm.
- [Ichiban Hibachi & Sushi (Flowood) (Flowood, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/ichiban-hibachi-and-sushi-flowood-ms): Spacious Flowood favorite off Lakeland Drive & Ridge Way serving fresh sushi rolls, custom hibachi grill plates, and warm hospitality.
- [Applebee's Grill + Bar (Clinton) (Clinton, MS) — 4.2/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/applebees-clinton-ms-bourbon-street-chicken-penne): Side-by-side Menu Photo vs. Reality video test on Hampstead Blvd in Clinton — moist Cajun chicken and genuinely smoky andouille sausage. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2JXq8A6KS2I)
- [Takara Grill & Sushi (Clinton, MS) — 1.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/takara-grill-and-sushi-clinton-ms): 100% unfiltered review with 5 real photos: beautiful interior and tasty steak, but a 46-minute wait in an empty room, ~$40/person counter service, and dry sushi.
- [Brandon Amphitheater (Brandon, MS) — 4.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/brandon-amphitheater-brandon-ms): Central Mississippi's premier outdoor concert bowl in Brandon — phenomenal music and atmosphere, with an honest warning about $7.50 bottled water in 90° heat.
- [Mississippi State Fairgrounds (Jackson, MS) — 2.5/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/mississippi-state-fairgrounds-jackson-ms): Awesome fireworks, classic cars, alpacas, and touching a real space meteorite on camera — paired with an honest parent warning on $8 Dr Peppers and $10-per-kid rides. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z8W7oJ_NF7c)
- [Landers Center (Southaven) (Southaven, MS) — 3.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/landers-center-southaven-ms): Major I-55 North MS arena in Southaven with surprisingly fair nacho/popcorn prices — but bring a jacket inside because door staff forbid truck re-entry!
- [New China Buffet (Batesville) (Batesville, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/new-china-buffet-batesville-ms): Dependable, clean 5-star highway buffet stop right off I-55 in Batesville when driving between Jackson, Southaven, and Memphis.
- [Bass Pro Shops at the Pyramid (I-55 Road Trip) (Memphis (North Border), MS) — 4.9/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/bass-pro-shops-pyramid-memphis-road-trip): 15 minutes north of Southaven up I-55 — Damein & Mary filmed inside the 32-story Pyramid's jaw-dropping Cypress Swamp packed with giant catfish and live gators. | [YouTube Video Review](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tv0peH1ghtI)
- [Wagon Master Steakhouse (Border Road Trip) (Leesville, LA, MS) — 5.0/5](https://thelocalguidems.com/reviews/wagon-master-steakhouse-leesville-la): From Damein's hometown Louisiana road trip — still a top-notch steakhouse 20 years later with perfectly cooked steaks, loaded baked potatoes, and great service from Tayler!
